notes.title: New CRT mode!
notes.notes:
Hi there,

The update time has come!
To give Pixboy an even more old-school look, I added the old TV screen mode (named CRT mode). Now it feels like playing it at an old console.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38169251/df5c62ab3af8c7963aef78e35dbdcaf4ed20778a.png[/img]

Also, every level was updated to provide you with a bit of a hint about where hidden rooms are. Now, there are different pixel patterns at their entrances, so you can spot them and hit a wall with Pixboy's head to reveal the secrets (or have a bump on the head).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38169251/7080253f79d5e53971541dd61c26ab0d49b11f6b.png[/img]

Thank you for playing Pixboy! 
May the RETRO be with you!

notes.title: New achievements and Forest levels update
notes.notes:
Hello, retro gamers!

We added [b]new achievements[/b] to give you more fun when playing!
1. [b]A Long Flight[/b] - fly for at least 30 seconds - do you know where you can perform such a long flight?
2. [b]Pacifist Spider Killer[/b] - how to make a spider kill itself?
3. [b]Heartful(l)[/b] - gather 7 hearts in one level. Are you good enough to not lose any heart?
4. [b]Jelly Killer[/b] - Jelly is your friend, but you can still kill it, in two different ways, actually...
5. [b]Bullet Hell[/b] - well, that's a hard one... you need to fire at least 30 bullets in one level. But which level has so many enemies?!
6. [b]Colorful[/b] - if you like colors in Pixboy, you will get an achievement for having all of them!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38169251/4239c04e90f7fd58cb84269b084340f050a8bb71.png[/img]

It's not all!
We watched many of your gameplays and based on them, we updated Forest levels to be more satisfying.
And these disappearing snails in the 7th level... well... they will not be running away anymore.

Thank you for playing!
Maciek
